notes: 36 pairs written by the project author (an AI assistant working for the owner) from settled public facts; passages are original paraphrases, not copied text.
Labels are by the author, so this set measures a baseline on the author's own distribution and is OPTIMISTIC for real model output. 'dev' (18) may be used to tune; 'test' (18) is scored once.
contradicted = the passage says something different from the claim. unsupported = the passage is topical but silent.
